items.summary: Synthetic demo transcript has no playable source audio
items.impacted_user_story: As an investor or reviewer, I need to play the source audio from a transcript segment or evidence citation so I can see how source-grounded review works.
items.observed_state: The synthetic workspace displays “Source playback is unavailable.” Text turns remain visible, but audio-to-transcript navigation cannot be demonstrated in this flow.
reproduction_steps: Start the offline synthetic browser fixture.
Open the workspace and choose Open synthetic example.
Inspect the player and try to activate a source turn.
acceptance_tests: The synthetic demo fixture supplies a valid local audio asset bound to its transcript version.
Play source from a transcript turn and from an evidence citation; assert the audio currentTime enters the cited source interval.
When audio is missing or invalid, display a recovery action and preserve the transcript without implying playback succeeded.

items.summary: Mobile source review requires a long scroll through repeated turn controls
items.impacted_user_story: As a clinician reviewing a long encounter on a narrow display, I need to move between source, correction, and note review without losing my place.
items.observed_state: The captured 390 px source screen is a tall single column with repeated per-turn actions followed by source review and walkthrough panels; the save action appears near the end of the turn list.
reproduction_steps: Open the synthetic example and select Source & transcript.
Scroll through the source turns to reach source review and save.
Return to an earlier turn and note the lost vertical position.
acceptance_tests: Add accessible section navigation or a persistent source-review action for narrow viewports.
A Playwright test reaches the source-review form and save action from the top-level workflow navigation without scrolling through every source-turn action.
Retain all source turns and correction controls; verify no horizontal overflow at 390 px.

items.summary: Keyboard users have no skip link past the encounter sidebar
items.impacted_user_story: As a keyboard or screen-reader user, I need to skip repeated encounter navigation and reach the main review content directly.
items.observed_state: The application shell renders the sidebar before the main landmark and has no skip-to-main link in the reviewed source.
reproduction_steps: Use only Tab from the start of the document.
Observe focus traversing sidebar actions before the main review region.
acceptance_tests: Add a visible-on-focus skip link that targets the main landmark.
Playwright asserts the skip link is the first keyboard stop in the workspace and Enter moves focus to main content.
Verify keyboard focus remains visible at desktop and mobile viewports.
